digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate orchestrator and integration with task-decomposition SOTA
propositions: Implement plan-review recommendations R1–R7 from task-decomposition SOTA report with falsifiable pass/fail thresholds drawn from experiment table §6, shipping advisory-first (non-blocking) where batch-eval gates are absent, with standing dogfood monitoring via d8a5 effectiveness recorder for advisory→blocking promotion.

Freeze outcome corpus (628 rows, event-mined) under docs/experiments/plan-review-gate/runs/ with versioned README; descope finding-adjudication/inter-rater-κ corpus due to tool-less contamination (~79%), parking the independent human-adjudicated gold set as deferred idea.

Re-plan R1/R3/R4 from batch-eval-gated to advisory-first (never-blocking) strategy with bounded ≤~8-run sanity check, superseding expensive LLM batch baselines (E2/E3) with zero-LLM sidecar-native effectiveness recorder (criterion_effectiveness.py, change #798).

Land all R1–R7 recommendations through Gerrit directly into packaged registry (no config-flag or overlay gating), with R6 shipped deterministic-first (no eval gate), R2/R5 gated on their own child terms, and advisory criteria auto-monitored for blocking-FP proxy >10% demotion threshold.

Coordinate R5's IMPACT_MODEL_VERSION bump with floor-split story (large-sleepful-needlefish) to avoid file conflicts on criteria_routing.json / review_kernel; sequence R3/R4 after floor-split to keep implementation children out of one batch.

Sequence E1 + R7 + R6 in first wave so dogfood monitoring exists before detection changes land; document advisory→blocking promotion gate in docs/plan-review-gate.md with R7 instrumentation (≥6/8 reproduction gate for standing recorder).
